name: Embrawl
summary:
Embrawl is fast, free first-person combat that runs right in the browser. Players drop into close-quarters fights across a sun-baked bazaar, a frozen harbor, seaside rooftops and a lava-lit ironworks, by day and by night.

Every player picks any gun, plus a pistol and two grenades, and takes it into Free for All, Team Deathmatch, Hardpoint, Capture the Flag and more. Vote on the next map, open a private lobby for friends, and collect and trade weapon skins!
